## Purpose

- Use R to answer management-research questions
- Work from script to evidence to interpretation
- Build reproducible habits from the first session

## The workflow

- Question → Data → Prepare → Explore → Test/Model → Interpret → Report
- R is a tool; research design determines what conclusions are defensible

## Course cases

- Employee survey
- Training experiment
- Marketing mix
- Hotel upgrades
- Replication sample

## Student workflow

- Open the `.Rproj` file
- Run code in short blocks
- Inspect before transforming
- Write an interpretation after each result

## Boundaries

- Beginner-friendly, applied, and selective
- No advanced programming or causal inference
- Simulated data are for learning—not organizational evidence
